About SideTippers Australia:

SideTippers Australia is a leading Australian manufacturer of premium side tippers and heavy transport equipment, supplying innovative solutions to the mining, agricultural, civil construction and transport industries. Due to continued growth, we are seeking a skilled and motivated Welder (First Class) to join our manufacturing team in Chadwick, Western Australia.

Responsibilities:

The Welder (First Class) is responsible for the fabrication, assembly, repair and maintenance of heavy transport equipment and fabricated steel components, ensuring all work is completed safely, efficiently and in accordance with engineering specifications, Australian Standards and company quality requirements.

Tasks:

•	Bring equipment, trailers and components into the workshop for fabrication, modification or repair.
•	Read and interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, specifications and cut lists to determine fabrication requirements.
•	Assess fabrication and repair work and plan welding and fabrication projects accurately to ensure efficient production outcomes.

•	Join metal sections using welding, bolting and riveting techniques where required.
•	Inspect completed welds to ensure quality, strength, penetration and compliance with engineering specifications.
•	Finish fabricated products by grinding, cleaning and polishing to achieve a high-quality finish.
•	Operate workshop equipment safely and maintain tools, machinery and equipment in good working order.
•	Work collaboratively with the workshop team to meet production schedules while maintaining a clean, organised and safe work environment.
•	Comply with all workplace health and safety procedures, company policies and quality standards.

Skills:

•	Proficiency in MIG, TIG and arc welding techniques.

•	Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team.
•	Strong commitment to workplace health and safety and safe work practices.

Experience:

•	Minimum 2 years' post-trade experience as a Welder (First Class) or in a similar fabrication role.
•	Experience manufacturing, repairing and modifying heavy machinery, trailers, transport equipment or structural steel.
•	Proven ability to work from engineering drawings and cut lists to produce accurate, high-quality fabrication work.
•	Experience operating workshop fabrication equipment and working in a heavy engineering or manufacturing environment.
•	Demonstrated ability to consistently deliver quality work while meeting production deadlines and company standards.

result.description:
6-Month Contract | Up to $90 per hour | Perth CBD  Your new company   Our client is a leading organisation within the WA industrial and process sector, playing a key role in supporting large-scale operations across the state. Due to multiple internal secondments, they are seeking an experienced Mechanical Engineer to join their team on an initial 6-month contract, with strong potential for extension.       Your new role   This is a varied, hands-on position supporting both project engineering and operational activities within a busy engineering function. You will work closely with operations and maintenance teams to deliver practical, high-quality engineering solutions.       Key responsibilities include:   
 
 Conveyor design for expansion projects (Sidewinder preferred)   
 Pneumatic system design (including hygiene air systems)   
 Conveyor skirting design and technical reviews   
 Throughput improvement and feasibility assessments   
 Troubleshooting equipment issues, including elevator performance   
 Managing a backlog of Engineering Work Requests (EWRs)   
 Coordinating external contractors and service providers   
 Providing engineering support to operations and maintenance teams   
 
    What you'll need to succeed   You are a versatile and adaptable Mechanical Engineer with a broad technical background and the ability to operate across multiple functions.       You will bring:   
 
 Degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent   
 Experience in mechanical engineering within process plant, materials handling, or industrial environments   
 Strong exposure to operations and maintenance support   
 Proven project engineering capability   
 Experience managing engineering work requests or similar scopes   
 Ability to coordinate contractors and manage stakeholders   
 Experience with Sidewinder conveyor design software desirable   
 
    What you'll get in return   
 
 Competitive hourly rate of up to $90 per hour (depending on experience)   
 Immediate start   
 Full-time hours (Monday to Friday, 40 hours per week)   
 Perth CBD location    
 Opportunity to join a high-performing and collaborative team   
 Potential for contract extension based on business needs   
 
    What you need to do now   If you're interested in this opportunity, click apply now. For more information or a confidential discussion, contact Taylah Brown at Hays on 08 9265 9128 or email taylah.brown@hays.com.au        At Hays, we value diversity and are passionate about placing people in roles where they can flourish and succeed. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply.    Please  click here  to apply.
